settings.sensitivity.help: How fast the mouse or right stick turns the drone and tilts the camera.
settings.invert.help: Push up to tilt the camera down.
settings.units.help: Altitude, distance and speed on the flight display.
settings.legend.help: When the drone controls show at the bottom right.
settings.view.help: The camera you see when you connect.
settings.acro.help: Glide keeps the drone level for you and leans it into turns. In first person, hold Shift with W A S D to flip or roll, or look past the top or below level to climb or dive where the camera points, and keep going over to flip. Let go and it levels out. Manual turns stabilisation off completely, for practised pilots.
settings.cineFrame.help: What cinematic mode draws over the clean feed. Vertical shades everything outside a 9:16 crop for TikTok, Reels and Shorts. Letterbox adds 2.39:1 film bars.
settings.startMode.help: The flight mode you are in when you connect. Acro switches on as soon as the drone has lifted off. Last used picks the mode you flew last.
settings.boost.help: Hold keeps the extra speed only while the key is held. Tap to toggle switches it on with one press and off with the next.
settings.acroRates.help: How fast the drone flips, rolls and turns in Acro. Lower is calmer and easier to place, higher snaps through tricks.
settings.acroExpo.help: Manual acro only. Softens the centre of the stick and keys so small corrections stay small, while full input still reaches the full rate.
settings.acroTilt.help: Manual acro only. How far the camera tilts up from the airframe. A steep angle suits fast forward flight, a shallow one slow cruising and hovering.
